blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever um resumo acadêmico sobre cultura organizacional, usando inversão, condicionais invertidas e atribuição.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Summary: Organizational Culture and Performance
paras: The article argues that culture, not strategy, **accounts for** most performance differences. **Only when** values are shared **does** culture drive results; **were** values merely printed on walls, **little would change**. Managers **attribute** failure **to** weak execution, **whereas** employees **put** it **down to** unclear leadership.
**Had** firms invested in dialogue, tensions **would have eased**. The authors **conclude** that culture is built daily, **not** declared once.

items.q: The article says culture explains performance differences.

items.why: merely printed on walls, little would change.

head: Função
Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: attribute A to B / put A down to B
**Only when values are shared does culture drive results.**
**Were values merely printed, little would change.**
**Had firms invested in dialogue, tension would have eased.**

blocks.body: Um bom resumo **combina** estruturas, mas mantém **uma ideia por frase**. Evite mais de duas inversões por parágrafo.

items.s: Only when values are shared ___ culture drive results. (does)
___ values merely printed, little would change. (Were)
___ firms invested in dialogue, tensions would have eased. (Had)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Walk the talk.** — Fazer o que se prega.
**Lead from the front.** — Liderar na linha de frente.
**Set the tone.** — Definir o tom.
**Read the room.** — Ler o ambiente.
**A culture of trust.** — Uma cultura de confiança.
**Rock the boat.** — Causar ruído.
**Buy in.** — Aderir.
**Walk on eggshells.** — Pisar em ovos.
**Who do managers blame?** — A quem os gerentes culpam?
**What does the article say accounts for performance?** — O que o artigo diz que explica o desempenho?
**Culture, but only when values are shared does it drive results.** — A cultura, mas só quando os valores são compartilhados ela gera resultados.

forms: I / you / we / they account for

items.label: Organização da informação pela entonação
items.note: A entonação organiza o discurso: queda = informação completa; subida = há mais por vir; a informação nova recebe o foco (nuclear stress).

prompts.model: Only when trust exists does teamwork thrive.
Had we communicated, tension would have eased.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence academic summary of the article using attribute to, only when… does and one inverted conditional.
blocks.model: The article argues that culture, rather than strategy, accounts for most performance differences. Only when values are shared does culture drive results. Managers attribute failure to weak execution, whereas employees put it down to unclear leadership. Had firms invested in dialogue, tensions would have eased. Were values merely printed on walls, little would change. The authors conclude that culture is built daily.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
